0022600129.text: The Detroit Pistons (3-0, 1st in the Central and 1st in the East) make the road trip to face the New York Knicks (0-3, 12th in the East and 2.5 games back in the Atlantic) in their fourth game of the season. Detroit is without Jalen Duren, who is out with a hamstring strain, and Ausar Thompson and Isaiah Joe are day-to-day with ankle and hip injuries and are game-time decisions, while New York is missing Jose Alvarado, who is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is also a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Detroit won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 126-111 win in New York on February 19, 2026.
